A.claim: A^3 + B^3 = C^p has no primitive nontrivial solutions for every prime p, not merely for p <= 700.

B.claim: A^5 + B^5 = C^p has no primitive nontrivial solutions for primes p >= 5, via Hilbert modular forms over Q(sqrt 5).
